title: QuestionReportAbuse - Data API
description: Represents a user-reported abuse on a Question in a Chatter Answers zone. This object is available in API version 24.0 and later.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The name of the Question from which the user reported abuse.

QuestionId.description: The ID of the Question from which the user reported abuse.

Reason.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Reason.description: The reason the user reported abuse on the Question, such as Spam, Hateful, or Inappropriate.

usage: Use this object to track user-reported abuse on questions created in a Chatter Answers zone.
